title: Finch Circle Program Team — Suspension, Review and Termination of Memberships
content:
**Suspension.** A Finch Circle Loyalty Program membership is suspended for review when, over the trailing 12 calendar months ending on the review date, the count of distinct returns on the membership's return deduction entries is at least the minimum number of returns and the returned share of purchases exceeds the return ratio threshold. The returned share is the qualifying amount on return deduction entries divided by the qualifying amount on purchase points entries, as a percent, both counted by entry date within those 12 months.

**While suspended.** No points post, no notes convert or redeem, no alteration credit is used and no tier benefit applies; points, notes and credit already held are kept.

**The review.** The Finch Circle program team decides the review: reinstatement returns the membership to active, and termination closes it with every points, note and credit balance forfeited. Customer care cannot suspend, reinstate or terminate a membership, and cannot shorten a review.

The minimum number of returns and the return ratio threshold are those of the program review thresholds.

## Truth table (hypothetical; minimum 10 returns, threshold 50 percent)

| Distinct returns in 12 months | Returned share | Suspended for review |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | 51 percent | yes |
| 9 | 80 percent | no |
| 12 | 50 percent | no (not above 50) |
| 15 | 20 percent | no |

## Points of judgement

- A suspended member keeps the points and notes already held while the review is open.
- Customer care cannot lift a suspension; only the program team's review returns the membership to active.
